name: physical_injected_revision_execution
description: Rebuild the four treatment tables from the real H6 workload, inject one frozen H8B revision scenario physically through each treatment's own write mechanism, and measure the statement time and the byte growth of that single revision.

protocol.execution: serial, one operator, no concurrent treatment run and no other workload on the node

orphan_cleanup.when: once, before the first baseline rebuild
orphan_cleanup.older_than: 25 hours before the measurement start, the shortest interval the Iceberg procedure accepts; every leftover object is three days old
orphan_cleanup.file_list: supplied from the MinIO listing of the table location, because the Spark image has no Hadoop file system for the s3 scheme

protocol.baseline_rebuild: DROP TABLE ... PURGE for every treatment table, then the treatment apply scripts in the order B0 B1 B2 B3

injection.B0: MERGE the synthetic rows into the current table, then expire snapshots to one
injection.B1: INSERT OVERWRITE the complete next state as a fourth retained snapshot
injection.B2: INSERT OVERWRITE the selection recomputed with the frozen H6B scores, then expire snapshots to one
injection.B3: INSERT the synthetic rows into the append-only store, MERGE only the dirty cells into the serving table, then expire snapshots to one on both tables

timing.boundary: in-session Spark SQL statement time reported by the Spark SQL CLI; JVM startup, catalog warm-up, and view creation are excluded from the treatment cost
timing.source: Time taken lines of one Spark SQL session per treatment
timing.aggregation: median over repetitions, reported with the minimum and maximum
timing.claim_limit: comparative between treatments on the declared 2 vCPU VM at fixture scale; never a performance or scalability claim

footprint.definition: bytes of every object reachable from the table metadata of retained snapshots
footprint.size_source: MinIO object listing of the table location

recall_after_revision.requests: every official observation of the H6 workload plus every synthetic observation of the scenario

access.B1: observation_id in any retained snapshot read with VERSION AS OF

measurement_boundary.profile_freeze: the main sweep profile and its one-source-per-run rule stay with H11

invariants: the catalog is persistent and the working tree is clean before any measurement starts
orphan files are removed once before the first baseline rebuild and the removal is recorded
every baseline rebuild reproduces the recorded treatment verification markers
every physical post-revision state equals the logical H9B state for the same scenario
every physical recall result equals the logical H9B recall audit for the same scenario
every metadata-referenced object exists in MinIO with the size recorded in metadata
B1 retains four snapshots after the revision while B0 B2 and B3 retain one per table
all repetitions are reported and aggregation happens only after row-level checks
timing is reported only for the declared environment and only as a comparison between treatments
